$comment: Time-bounded credentials this automation depends on. GitHub publishes no API that returns a fine-grained PAT's expiry (the GitHub-Authentication-Token-Expiration header reports the current time for these, google/go-github#3708), and no endpoint lists a personal account's tokens — so a declared date here is the only way to get advance warning. Keep `expires` correct: scripts/check-credential-expiry.js is what stands between a quiet expiry and a week of confusing workflow failures.

credentials.name: AUTOFIX_PAT
credentials.usedBy: .github/workflows/security-autofix.yml — pushes the remediation branch and opens the PR, so its checks actually run
credentials.renewal: Create a replacement at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens (repository access: MikeGira/taskpilot only; Contents: read+write, Pull requests: read+write), then update the AUTOFIX_PAT secret at https://github.com/MikeGira/taskpilot/settings/secrets/actions and correct `expires` here. Better: migrate security-autofix.yml to a GitHub App token and delete this entry.

credentials.name: SWEEP_PAT
credentials.usedBy: MikeGira/claude-dotfiles .github/workflows/cross-repo-sweep.yml — enumerates public and private repos for the daily security sweep
credentials.renewal: Create a replacement at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens with read access to all repos to be swept, then update the SWEEP_PAT secret in MikeGira/claude-dotfiles and correct `expires` here. Not probed from this repo because the secret does not live here — the date is the only signal, so keep it accurate.
